clinicalPearls: Six month course with functional decline (DSM pattern)
Clozapine after two failed antipsychotics, with blood monitoring
Negative and cognitive symptoms drive disability
Relapse prevention needs continuation 1 to 2 years after first episode
reference.pathophysiology: Genetic and neurodevelopmental vulnerability interacts with adolescent pruning, cannabis, migration and urban stress to produce striatal presynaptic dopamine dysregulation, with glutamatergic cortical dysfunction underlying cognitive and negative features.
additionalDifferentials: Schizophrenia versus schizoaffective (mood episode overlap rule)
Schizophrenia versus brief psychotic and delusional disorders by duration and symptoms
Primary negative symptoms versus depression, parkinsonism and positive symptom withdrawal
additionalInvestigations: Structured diagnostic interview and collateral timeline
Substance screen, medical exclusion labs and imaging when indicated
Baseline metabolic, ECG and prolactin checks before antipsychotics
